nodes.name: funnel.py
nodes.summary: Database service layer for the systematic-review funnel: reference imports, dedup regrouping into papers, split/merge, criteria versions, AI screening runs and human decisions, pending actions, full-text linking, extraction columns, filtered listing/counting/export and stratified label samples, all scoped by server-checked project id.

nodes.name: references.py
nodes.summary: Parses reference exports (PubMed/MEDLINE .nbib, BibTeX/Europe PMC, RIS, Scopus/Web of Science CSV/TSV, Excel) into normalised Pydantic Record objects, sniffing the format from content and reporting unreadable records instead of dropping them.

nodes.name: screening.py
nodes.summary: Title/abstract screening logic: Pydantic criteria/verdict schemas, free metadata checks (year, language, publication type), one quoted AI verdict call per paper with quote verification, extract-field filters, the include/exclude/review decision rule, criteria drafting and cost estimates; fail-safe so unverifiable answers go to review.

nodes.name: test_dedup.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for dedup grouping: transitive DOI/PMID merges, title+author+year matching rules, DOI/PMID conflicts blocking merges, preprint separation, possible-duplicate listing and order-independent canonical record choice.

nodes.name: test_evaluate_screening.py
nodes.summary: Tests for evaluate_screening: metric computation (recall on includes, precision, review pile) and the gold-set export of blind labels, newest rows and superseded preprints, including CLI refusal of empty gold sets.

nodes.name: Conflict
nodes.summary: The request is valid but the data says no (e.g. keep_article on a pair with no preprint).

nodes.name: lock
nodes.summary: Serialise imports/splits/merges of one project (Postgres row lock; SQLite has one writer anyway).

nodes.name: _paper_fields
nodes.summary: Canonical fields: the best record first, gaps filled from the others; publication types from all of them.

nodes.name: paper_out
nodes.summary: Serialises a Paper row to the API dict shape.

nodes.name: carry
nodes.summary: Move a paper's work onto the paper that replaces it (before src is dropped): its PDF link when dst has none, decisions per criteria version (a human decision, blind label or feedback fills what dst lacks), extracted values dst lacks or has...

nodes.name: _reuse_ids
nodes.summary: Per group, the earlier paper id it keeps (or None): each earlier paper goes to the group holding most of its references, each group takes at most one, largest overlaps first.

nodes.name: _save_group
nodes.summary: The paper for these free references: the earlier paper `pid` (keeping its id, decisions and values), or new.

nodes.name: regroup
nodes.summary: Rebuild papers from all the project's references. Pinned references (user splits/merges) never move: a dedup group touching one pinned paper adds its free references to that paper; a group touching several (the user split them) keeps its...

nodes.name: import_summary
nodes.summary: Builds the import response with record counts and project paper/duplicate totals.

nodes.name: import_file
nodes.summary: (summary, created). Raises ValueError when nothing in the file can be read.

nodes.name: decision_fields
nodes.summary: Serialises a screening decision's AI and human fields, hiding AI fields in blind mode.

nodes.name: list_papers
nodes.summary: blind: the AI's verdicts and decisions (and the decision tab counts that would reveal them) are left out.

nodes.name: split
nodes.summary: One paper per reference, all pinned. None if the paper is not in this project; [] if nothing to split.

nodes.name: resolve_duplicate
nodes.summary: merge: paper_b's references join paper_a (pinned, reason manual); dismiss: hide the pair for good; keep_article: the preprint of the pair is marked superseded by the journal article (kept, not screened).

nodes.name: latest_version
nodes.summary: Highest criteria version number for a project.

nodes.name: criteria_set
nodes.summary: Fetches a project's criteria set by version, defaulting to the latest.

nodes.name: criteria_out
nodes.summary: Serialises a criteria set to the API dict shape.

nodes.name: save_criteria
nodes.summary: A new criteria version; sentence None keeps the previous version's sentence.

nodes.name: run_test
nodes.summary: Screen a TEST_SAMPLE of papers under the latest criteria (test rows, not decisions). Already tested under this version: the stored rows, at no cost. None if there are no criteria yet.

nodes.name: set_feedback
nodes.summary: Thumbs up/down on a test row of the latest criteria version. None if that paper was not in the test.

nodes.name: _current_row
nodes.summary: The paper's row under this version, created (with the human work carried from its newest row) if missing.

nodes.name: set_decision
nodes.summary: changes: {"decision": include|exclude|None, "reason"} (None clears the human decision) and/or {"blind_label"}. Applies to the latest criteria version. None if the paper is not in this project; Conflict without criteria. A blind_label-only...

nodes.name: _screen_plan
nodes.summary: (criteria, todo). todo: (paper dict, copied verdicts, criteria to ask) for each paper without an AI decision under this version. AI yes/no verdicts from the paper's newest screened earlier version are copied when that criterion is...

nodes.name: screen_estimate
nodes.summary: Estimates model calls/tokens for screening the remaining papers, excluding free metadata exclusions.

nodes.name: _write_batch
nodes.summary: Write AI results onto each paper's row under this version, read fresh now: a decision the user made while we screened is kept, not overwritten or collided with.

nodes.name: screen_all
nodes.summary: Screen every paper without an AI decision under this criteria version, committing every SCREEN_BATCH papers (a re-run continues where a crash stopped).

nodes.name: action_out
nodes.summary: Serialises a pending action to the API dict shape.

nodes.name: Invalid
nodes.summary: The request is malformed for this data (e.g. extracting from the duplicates tab).

nodes.name: NotFound
nodes.summary: A referenced row (e.g. an extraction column) is not in this project.

nodes.name: propose
nodes.summary: A pending action with its estimate; nothing runs until the owner confirms it. Conflict without criteria (an extraction on the "all" tab needs none); NotFound for a column of another project.

nodes.name: included_without_pdf
nodes.summary: Papers whose final decision (latest criteria) is include and that have no usable PDF yet (none, or one whose ingest failed: fetching again re-queues it).

nodes.name: linked_elsewhere
nodes.summary: The document already is another paper's PDF (one PDF never stands for two papers).

nodes.name: link_document
nodes.summary: Sets a paper's linked document, full-text status, URL and license.

nodes.name: match_document
nodes.summary: Link an uploaded PDF to the included paper its first page names, if exactly one confidently matches and the document is not linked yet. Candidates: included papers still without a PDF (tens, not the whole export).

nodes.name: extracted_counts
nodes.summary: For each extracted field of the latest criteria: how many screened papers have each value ("18 retrospective cohort, 2 prospective cohort"); "no answer" = a failed call or an unverified value.

nodes.name: column_out
nodes.summary: Serialises an extraction column to the API dict shape.

nodes.name: add_column
nodes.summary: Conflict when the project already has a column of that name (values are shown by name).

nodes.name: project_column
nodes.summary: Fetches an extraction column only if it belongs to the given project.

nodes.name: list_columns
nodes.summary: Lists a project's extraction columns in creation order.

nodes.name: column_values
nodes.summary: All values stored for one extraction column with paper titles.

nodes.name: _papers_in_tab
nodes.summary: superseded=False (extraction, the default) leaves out preprints replaced by their article; True counts them like the tabs and funnel status do.

nodes.name: extract_targets
nodes.summary: (paper, sha of its ingested PDF or None) for papers in the tab that still need a value: none yet, or one read from the abstract before the paper's PDF finished ingesting. `only`: the paper ids a confirmed action covers.

nodes.name: save_value
nodes.summary: The stored row: a new "not stated" never replaces a value already found (e.g. from the abstract).

nodes.name: paper_columns
nodes.summary: {paper id: {column name: {value, source, quote}}} for a page of papers.

nodes.name: _tab_data
nodes.summary: (papers in the tab, their decisions, their extracted values). Invalid for a tab that is not a paper list.

nodes.name: _filtered
nodes.summary: The tab's papers matching f: year_from / year_to (inclusive), database (one of the paper's sources), and column + value (its extracted value, case-insensitive). None = no filter. ponytail: filters in Python over the whole tab; push into...

nodes.name: find_papers
nodes.summary: Filtered papers as listing items (paper, decision, extracted values).

nodes.name: count_papers
nodes.summary: Counts of the (filtered) tab's papers by year, database (a paper in two databases counts in both), decision, journal, or an extracted column's value (f["column"]): the most common MAX_COUNTS values, then `other` (the rest) and `distinct`...

nodes.name: export_table
nodes.summary: (headers, rows): one row per paper in the tab — citation, final decision, full-text status, and per extraction column its value, quote and source. Invalid for a tab that is not a paper list (duplicates). ponytail: whole tab in memory;...

nodes.name: make_label_sample
nodes.summary: Draw the fixed, stratified sample to blind-label: up to a third from the AI's includes, a third of the rest from review, the rest from excluded (where a missed include hides); a small pile's share goes to the others. Shuffled together so a...

nodes.name: Record
nodes.summary: Pydantic normalised reference record (source, ids, title, abstract, authors, year, journal, types, languages).

nodes.name: strip_html
nodes.summary: Removes HTML tags and unescapes entities, collapsing whitespace.

nodes.name: norm_doi
nodes.summary: Normalises a DOI by stripping resolver prefixes and lowercasing.

nodes.name: norm_title
nodes.summary: Normalises a title to lowercase alphanumeric tokens for matching.

nodes.name: _surname
nodes.summary: "von Damm, Isabela" -> von damm; MEDLINE "Smith J" / "Tussing-Humphreys LA" -> smith; "Jane Smith" -> smith.

nodes.name: _medline_blocks
nodes.summary: Splits MEDLINE text into per-record tag blocks, joining continuation lines.

nodes.name: parse_medline
nodes.summary: Parses PubMed/MEDLINE .nbib text into Records and error messages.

nodes.name: _braced
nodes.summary: Index just past the brace that closes the one at text[i], or -1 if it never closes. Escaped braces don't count.

nodes.name: _quoted
nodes.summary: Index just past the quote closing the one at text[i] (quotes inside braces don't close), or -1.

nodes.name: _fields
nodes.summary: Fields of one entry, and a problem message if part of it could not be read (fields before it are kept).

nodes.name: _bib_record
nodes.summary: Builds a Record from one BibTeX entry, recognising Europe PMC keys.

nodes.name: parse_bibtex
nodes.summary: Every "@type{" start is either a record or an error: nothing is skipped silently. Each step moves forward.

nodes.name: database_code
nodes.summary: The stored source code for a database name as people write it ("Web of Science" -> wos), or None.

nodes.name: parse_ris
nodes.summary: Parses RIS exports into Records, handling tag variants and reporting bad records.

nodes.name: _table_records
nodes.summary: Maps tabular export rows (Scopus/WoS column names) to Records, reporting rows without a title.

nodes.name: parse_csv
nodes.summary: Delimiter = the most frequent of tab / semicolon / comma in the header line; quotes are standard CSV ("" inside a quoted field), which is what Scopus, WoS and Excel write.

nodes.name: parse_xlsx
nodes.summary: Reads the first sheet of an Excel export via openpyxl into Records.

nodes.name: parse_file
nodes.summary: Records and error messages. The format is sniffed from the content (extensions lie: PubMed exports .txt).

nodes.name: Criterion
nodes.summary: Pydantic screening criterion: include_if/exclude_if, check type (metadata/ai/extract), field and extract options.

nodes.name: CriteriaDraft
nodes.summary: LLM output schema wrapping a drafted list of criteria.

nodes.name: Verdict
nodes.summary: Per-criterion verdict (yes/no/unclear) with verbatim quote, reason and optional extracted value.

nodes.name: AiScreen
nodes.summary: LLM output schema wrapping a paper's verdicts.

nodes.name: _languages
nodes.summary: ISO 639-2 codes of a record's languages ("English", "fre|eng"); None if any of them is not recognised.

nodes.name: check_metadata
nodes.summary: The verdict from the record's own data, or None when that data is missing (the AI then reads the abstract).

nodes.name: quote_words
nodes.summary: How many words of the quote appear as whole words of text (normalised; wrapping quote marks ignored; parts around an ellipsis must appear in order), or None if it is not found.

nodes.name: apply_extract
nodes.summary: The user's filter on an extracted value: in exclude_values -> yes (excluded); another stated option -> no (passes); "not stated", no answer or anything else -> unclear (review), never an exclusion.

nodes.name: reapply_extract
nodes.summary: A stored value under a new filter, or None to ask the model again (it would now exclude on a quote shorter than an exclusion needs).

nodes.name: screen_paper
nodes.summary: One verdict per criterion, in criteria order. Metadata first; everything else in one model call. A paper that metadata already excludes is not sent to the model: its unchecked criteria get no verdict.

nodes.name: screen_many
nodes.summary: Screens papers concurrently in a thread pool.

nodes.name: excludes
nodes.summary: Whether a verdict excludes a paper under its criterion's kind/check.

nodes.name: decide
nodes.summary: exclude: an include_if criterion is not met, or an exclude_if criterion is met. review: anything unclear, or an AI criterion without an abstract to read. Else include.

nodes.name: validate_criteria
nodes.summary: Why a user-edited criteria list can't be saved, or None.

nodes.name: draft_criteria
nodes.summary: Criteria cards from the user's sentence; ids c1..cn; a metadata check the code cannot run becomes an AI check.

nodes.name: test_sample
nodes.summary: Half likely matches (an AI criterion's keywords appear in the title/abstract), half random, reproducible by seed.

nodes.name: estimate
nodes.summary: Model calls and tokens for screening these papers (metadata-only criteria cost nothing). No prices: the model behind the env setting decides those.

nodes.name: test_metrics_count_recall_on_includes_precision_and_review_pile
nodes.summary: Test: metrics count recall on includes precision and review pile.

nodes.name: test_export_writes_blind_labels_with_paper_fields_and_criteria
nodes.summary: Test: export writes blind labels with paper fields and criteria.

nodes.name: test_export_uses_each_papers_newest_row_and_skips_superseded_preprints
nodes.summary: Test: export uses each papers newest row and skips superseded preprints.

nodes.name: test_export_cli_refuses_empty_gold_sets_and_overwrites
nodes.summary: Test: export cli refuses empty gold sets and overwrites.
